prompt: prometheus operator Route continue field first-level route override
answer:
For an `AlertmanagerConfig`, the Prometheus Operator always overrides `spec.route.continue` to `true` when the route becomes a first-level route. Setting it to `false` has no effect.

This allows alerts to continue matching subsequent sibling routes. Child routes retain their configured `continue` value.
